## What is a time series?

A time series is a sequence of observations collected
over time, usually at regular intervals.

Examples include:

- Daily call-center volume
- Monthly sales
- Hourly electricity demand
- Annual unemployment rates

## Creating a time series in Python

Let's create a simple example using pandas.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

dates = pd.date_range(
    start="2026-01-01",
    periods=30,
    freq="D"
)

volume = pd.Series(
    range(100, 130),
    index=dates,
    name="volume"
)

volume.plot(title="Example Daily Volume")
plt.xlabel("Date")
plt.ylabel("Volume")
plt.show()
```

This example creates 30 daily observations and plots
them over time.

## Why does time order matter?

Unlike ordinary independent observations, time-series
data can contain trends, seasonality, and serial
dependence.

Understanding these patterns helps us select
appropriate forecasting methods.
